$schema_note: Codomain ranges for QxFx0_v3 calibration parameters. Each entry pins a (parameter, source file, field, default value) tuple with a closed range [lo, hi]. The check_calibration_codomain.sh script reads this file and verifies the default value is in the range. The list is the initial seed; expand per CALIBRATION_BACKLOG.md as Packages 7-11 land.

parameters.name: SalienceWeights.weightResonance
parameters.rationale: Field.fieldResonance is in [0, 1] (per CALIBRATION_BACKLOG.md §2.1). The weight itself is unconstrained; the codomain of the gated signal is the constraint.

parameters.name: SalienceWeights.stateIntegrityGateThreshold
parameters.rationale: StateIntegrity.siScalar is in [~5, ~20+] in production, but can be negative under heavy violation (per ADR-0012 §15.1, the codomain is the production range, not [0, 1]). The gate threshold itself is on the same scale; we pin a wider range to allow for calibration. The actual codomain check is in CALIBRATION_REPORT.md (F-10).

parameters.name: SalienceWeights.verdictThreshold
parameters.rationale: Per CALIBRATION_BACKLOG.md §2.1, the dead-band is a fraction of [0, 0.5]; the threshold is the half-width.

parameters.name: SalienceWeights.sigmoidTemperature
parameters.rationale: Sigmoid temperature; positive by construction. Range chosen to keep the sigmoid numerically well-conditioned.

parameters.name: StateIntegrityWeights.siwMorphology
parameters.rationale: State-integrity weight; positive by construction. Range chosen to allow for calibration without breaking the energy codomain.

parameters.name: StateIntegrityWeights.siwIdentity
parameters.rationale: State-integrity weight; same scale as siwMorphology.

parameters.name: StateIntegrityWeights.siwTurns
parameters.rationale: State-integrity weight; same scale as siwMorphology.

parameters.name: StateIntegrityWeights.siwViolation
parameters.rationale: State-integrity weight; same scale as siwMorphology. Higher value reflects the importance of violation in the energy functional.

parameters.name: emStateIntegrityStructuralFloor
parameters.rationale: Already calibrated in ADR-0012 §15.1 (corrected from 0.5 to 7.0). The codomain is the StateIntegrity range, not [0, 1].

parameters.name: StructWeights.swHead
parameters.rationale: structScore weight (hand-set v1, calibration group 3); gated signal is the [0,1] structural match.

parameters.name: StructWeights.swRel
parameters.rationale: structScore weight (hand-set v1, calibration group 3); gated signal is the [0,1] structural match.

parameters.name: StructWeights.swMod
parameters.rationale: structScore weight (hand-set v1, calibration group 3); gated signal is the [0,1] structural match.

parameters.name: StructWeights.swNeg
parameters.rationale: structScore weight (hand-set v1, calibration group 3); gated signal is the [0,1] structural match.

parameters.name: AssemblyEndorsement.assemblyEndorsementBonus
parameters.rationale: composition weight bonus for gate-passing assemblies (hand-set v1, calibration group 3); max-once per topic.
